dhp256:0.3: 19: The Chapter about one who stands by Dhamma
dhp256:1: One who would hastily settle a case because of that is not one who stands by Dhamma,
dhp256:3: the wise one should discriminate the two: what is the case and what is not the case.
dhp257:1: The one who settles for other people without haste, justly and impartially,
dhp257:4: is said to be one who stands by Dhamma.
dhp258:1: One is not a wise person
dhp258:4: one is called a wise person.
dhp259:3: but the one who, having heard a little,
dhp259:6: the one who is not heedless regarding Dhamma.
dhp260:2: because one’s head has grey hair,
dhp260:3: for the one who is (only) well-matured, aged,
dhp260:4: is said to be old in vain.
dhp261:3: the wise one who throws out the stain
dhp263:1: for the one in whom this is cut off,
dhp263:2: destroyed at the root, dug up,
dhp263:3: that sage who has thrown out hatred
dhp264:1: Not through a shaven head is one an ascetic,
dhp264:3: and is endowed with greed and desire,
dhp264:4: how will one be an ascetic?
dhp265:1: The one who pacifies wicked deeds,
dhp265:2: small and great, in every way –
dhp265:3: through the pacifing of wicked deeds
dhp265:4: he is said to be an ascetic.
dhp266:3: the one who undertakes a false Dhamma
dhp266:4: to that extent is not a monastic.
dhp267:1: If he is one who lives the holy life here, warding off both merit and demerit,
dhp267:3: and wanders with discrimination in the world,
dhp267:4: that one is said to be a monastic.
dhp268:1: Not through silence is a deluded fool (considered to be) a seer,
dhp268:3: the wise one, like one holding the balance,
dhp269:1: The seer who rejects wicked deeds through that is (considered) a seer,
dhp269:4: because of that is said to be a seer.
dhp270:1: Not through hurting breathing beings one is noble,
dhp270:3: the one who does not hurt any breathing beings
dhp271:1: Not merely through virtue or vows,
dhp271:3: or through the attainment of concentration,
dhp272:1: do I attain the happiness of renunciation,
dhp272:3: let a monastic not be confident
dhp272:4: (as long as) the destruction of the pollutants is unattained.
dhp272:5: The Chapter about the one who stands by Dhamma, the Nineteenth Endowed with virtue and insight, principled, knowing the truths, doing the deeds that are his own, that one the people love.
